entries.name: data.label.arrow
entries.description: Get/set arrow status. If b is true, then the line associated with the label (if it exists) is drawn as an arrow. Otherwise, it is drawn as a simple line.

entries.name: data.label.create
entries.description: Create a label.

entries.name: data.label.delete
entries.description: Delete a label.

entries.name: data.label.end
entries.description: Get/set the end position. If the optional end position is different from the value returned by data.label.pos, then an arrow is drawn with the label.

entries.name: data.label.end.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the end position. If the optional end position is different from the value returned by data.label.pos, then an arrow is drawn with the label.

entries.name: data.label.end.y
entries.description: Get/set the y-component of the end position. If the optional end position is different from the value returned by data.label.pos, then an arrow is drawn with the label.

entries.name: data.label.end.z
entries.description: Get/set the z-component of the end position. If the optional end position is different from the value returned by data.label.pos, then an arrow is drawn with the label.

entries.name: data.label.find
entries.description: Find a label. If the label does not exist a new label is created.

entries.name: data.label.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to label lp in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: data.label.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the label in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: data.label.head
entries.description: Get the head of the global label list. Use the data.label.next construct to iterate through the list.

entries.name: data.label.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the label and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: data.label.list
entries.description: Get the global label list. Use the loop foreach construct to iterate through the list.

entries.name: data.label.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum label ID.

entries.name: data.label.name
entries.description: Get the label name.

entries.name: data.label.next
entries.description: Get the next label. Returns null if there are no more labels in the global list.

entries.name: data.label.num
entries.description: Get the number of labels.

entries.name: data.label.pos
entries.description: Get/set the position. The text and a line or arrow are drawn from this position to the end position (specified with data.label.end).

entries.name: data.label.pos.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the position. The text and a line or arrow are drawn from this position to the end position (specified with data.label.end).

entries.name: data.label.pos.y
entries.description: Get/set the y-component of the position. The text and a line or arrow are drawn from this position to the end position (specified with data.label.end).

entries.name: data.label.pos.z
entries.description: Get/set the z-component of the position. The text and a line or arrow are drawn from this position to the end position (specified with data.label.end).

entries.name: data.label.text
entries.description: Get/set the label text. This is optional (e.g., if set to “”, no text will be drawn), and will be drawn at the label position.

entries.name: data.label.typeid
entries.description: Get the label type ID number. The type ID can be used to uniquely identify label FISH pointers and distinguish them from any other type of FISH pointer.
